meta.name: init-next-logging
meta.description: Initializes production-ready logging for a Next.js project using Pino + pino-roll with file output and log rotation. Use when setting up a new Next.js project, adding logging infrastructure, or when the user asks to initialize Next.js logging with log rotation and file output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 Next.js 项目的生产级日志,支持文件输出与轮转
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在搭建 Next.js 项目并需要可靠的日志系统
copy.tagline_en: Initialize production-ready logging for Next.js with file output and rotation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're setting up a Next.js project and need solid logging

howto.what: 为 Next.js 项目搭建 Pino + pino-roll 日志系统:安装依赖,创建 logger、请求上下文包装器和 instrumentation 文件,修改 next.config.js 启用 instrumentationHook,建 logs 目录并更新 .gitignore。日志以 JSON 格式写入文件,按大小或时间轮转并保留备份。
howto.when: 当用户新建 Next.js 项目、添加日志基础设施,或要求初始化带日志轮转和文件输出的日志时。先询问部署目标,若是 Vercel/Serverless 则跳过文件输出。

say.text: 给我的 Next.js 项目配置 Pino 日志,要文件输出和日志轮转。
say.note: Claude 会安装依赖并搭建日志模块。

say.text: 初始化日志,部署目标是自托管 VPS,日志级别用 debug。
say.note: 会按 debug 级别配置并启用文件日志。

say.text: 把现有 Next.js 项目加上日志,轮转策略按大小 10m。
say.note: 会配置 10MB 大小触发轮转。

howto.what_en: Sets up Pino + pino-roll logging for a Next.js project: installs dependencies, creates logger, request-context wrapper and instrumentation file, enables instrumentationHook in next.config.js, creates logs dir and updates .gitignore. Logs are written as JSON with rotation by size or time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user starts a new Next.js project, adds logging infrastructure, or asks to initialize logging with rotation and file output. It first asks about the deployment target; for Vercel/Serverless it skips file output.

say_en.text: Set up Pino logging for my Next.js project with file output and rotation.
say_en.note: Claude installs dependencies and creates the logging modules.

say_en.text: Initialize logging for self-hosted VPS deployment at debug level.
say_en.note: Configures debug level with file logging.

say_en.text: Add logging to my Next.js app with 10m size-based rotation.
say_en.note: Sets up rotation after each 10MB file.
